comment: nhlua.c load_lua() through wiz_load_lua() runs a level program (minefill) on the current level: its first des.* call creates gc.coder (sp_level_coder_init() resets the level flags and frame), its monsters are made outside level creation, so makemon() runs its runtime tail, and nothing post-processes the level. C draws 2,304 random numbers at the Enter. Seed, date and Samurai chosen independently.
